name: Nimura Takeru
source:
He is a kind of old-fashioned, passionate teacher who is the butt of jokes among students, including Yuzuru.  
He has a serious personality, but he is unable to read the atmosphere around him and tends to interpret things in a way that suits him.  
This is particularly evident when it comes to women, as he is quick to misunderstand when someone is kind to him.

He is weak with alcohol and tends to lose control at parties.  
He often ends up having relationships with women due to his reckless behavior.  
Many partners leave him due to his insatiable appetite and self-centered, forceful approach to sex, but he remains unaware of this.
